info.title: PG Management & Operations Platform API
info.description:
Transactional API for multi-property PG/co-living operations.
Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login and use the access token as a Bearer token.
All errors share one envelope: {timestamp, status, error, code, message, path, correlationId}.
Payment and refund creation require an Idempotency-Key header.

put.summary: Update layout/pricing; rent changes affect new allocations only

post.summary: Create a staff/admin account (optionally assigned to properties)
Deactivate an account and revoke all of its sessions immediately

get.summary: Search tenants by name/email/phone with status, property and joining-date filters

post.summary: Register a resident (status PROSPECTIVE until check-in)
Create a self-service TENANT login for the resident
Record ID document metadata; only a masked number is stored
Create a room in a property; beds are generated from the capacity

get.summary: List properties visible to the caller (org-wide for admins, assigned ones for managers/staff)

post.summary: Assign a MANAGER or STAFF user to the property
Record a payment against an invoice (idempotent: retry with the same Idempotency-Key)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key (UUID) - identical retries return the original payment

post.summary: Refund (part of) a payment, e.g. the security deposit at move-out. Idempotent.
Raise a maintenance request (tenants: property/room derived from their allocation)
Move the ticket through OPEN -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED -> CLOSED
Add an additional charge (electricity, laundry, late fee ...) to an invoice
Run monthly rent generation now (idempotent; normally scheduled daily)
Escalate a complaint one level (tenants only once the deadline has passed)
Reserve an AVAILABLE bed for a prospective tenant (hold expires automatically)
Rotate the refresh token and obtain a new access token
Revoke the current session (refresh token family + current access token)
Revoke every session of the current user on all devices
Exchange credentials for an access token (15 min) and a rotating refresh token
Change own password; all sessions are revoked and the user must log in again
Move a tenant to another bed/room/property
Check a tenant out; frees the bed and returns the deposit settlement
Check a tenant into a bed (against a reservation or walk-in); issues deposit + first rent invoice

patch.summary: Toggle a bed between AVAILABLE and MAINTENANCE

get.summary: Outstanding balance, deposit held and open invoices of a tenant
Stay history of a tenant, including transfers
Live bed occupancy of a property
Download the payment receipt as PDF
Search invoices; tenants only see their own
Dashboard for the current user's role
JSON Web Key Set used to verify access tokens
Search the audit trail of the caller's organization
Search allocations; expectedEndBefore lists upcoming check-outs
